newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end at 22-month high of 763.5 pts.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end at 22-month high of 763.5 pts.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks broke through the psychological 750-point barrier on Wednesday to touch a 22-month high on improved investor sentiment and corporate earnings, brokers said.

The all share index closed 16.3 points up at 763.5. The index last crossed the 750 mark on August 8, 1995 when it closed at 751.2 points. John Keells Holdings rose eight rupees to 280, National Development Bank 19 to 239.
"Sentiment has imporved this year and on top of that earnings for the year to March and the first quarter of 1997 have also improved," said Dihan Dedigama of brokerage John Keells.
